evidence_notes: archimatetool__archi::CVE-2023-40235: Vulnerable checkout ad679a46 already disables DOCTYPE, external DTD, external general entities, and external parameter entities. Fix bcab676b adds XMLResource.OPTION_USE_PACKAGE_NS_URI_AS_LOCATION=false with explicit comment about preventing unregistered URI loading. This cleanly supports a distinct mechanism boundary.
The single-case coverage is expected for a newly split boundary (boundary_decision=split_further). The evidence is thorough and directly supports the mechanism claim.
main_issue: Single representative case limits coverage, but the mechanism is coherently defined and well-evidenced. The boundary correctly distinguishes namespace/package URI location loading from classic XXE (parser features already disabled). The recall_follow_up field appropriately acknowledges the need for future same-identity recall expansion.
mechanism_name: XML namespace/package URI external location loading

evidence_notes: allure-framework__allure2::CVE-2025-52888: Source-backed with pre-fix and post-fix commit hashes. DocumentBuilderFactory without entity resolver in test result XML parsing. Clear evidence.

apache__cxf-fediz::CVE-2018-8038: Source-backed. Static DocumentBuilderFactory with FEATURE_SECURE_PROCESSING but missing disallow-doctype-decl. Demonstrates that partial secure processing is insufficient. Clear evidence.

aws_amplify__aws_sdk_android::CVE-2022-4725: Source-backed. Two separate parser utilities (XpathUtils, RegionMetadataParser) both missing secure features. Demonstrates the mechanism can appear in multiple code paths in the same project. Clear evidence.

bonitasoft__bonita-connector-webservice::CVE-2020-36640: Source-backed. Covers both DocumentBuilderFactory (SOAP/XML document creation) and TransformerFactory (XML transformation) without ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD/SCHEMA/STYLESHEET. This is the strongest evidence for the transformer variant of the mechanism. Clear evidence.
main_issue: The boundary is well-defined and coherent. All four cases share the same mechanism: Java XML parser/transformer factory construction or reuse without a complete external-resource, DOCTYPE, or external-access guard before processing attacker-influenced XML. The explicit exclusion of XMLDecoder, XPath expression injection, and EMF namespace URI cases is a strong boundary hygiene signal. Minor note: the Bonita case also involves TransformerFactory (not just DocumentBuilderFactory), which is correctly captured in the boundary text, but the evidence_refs could more explicitly call out the TransformerFactory path as a distinct variant within the same mechanism.
mechanism_name: unsafe XML parser external entity or DTD resolution
